title: GraphQL-to-MCP Tool Definitions
description: MCP tool definitions mapped to existing GraphQL operations

graphqlOperation.query: query healthCheck { healthCheck { status database version } }

tools.name: systemStats
tools.description: Get system statistics and performance metrics

graphqlOperation.query: query systemStats { systemStats { memory { used total percentage } process { pid cpu platform } } }

tools.name: createTable
tools.description: Create a new table in the graph database

graphqlOperation.query: mutation createTable($input: CreateTableInput!) { createTable(input: $input) { success table { id identifier description } errors { message } } }

searchTerm.description: Search term for table name or description

graphqlOperation.query: query searchTables($filter: TablesFilter) { tables(filter: $filter) { nodes { id identifier description } } }

tools.name: createNode
tools.description: Create a new node in a table

tableId.description: ID of the table to create node in

graphqlOperation.query: mutation createNode($input: CreateNodeInput!) { createNode(input: $input) { success node { id content table { id identifier } createdAt } errors { message } } }

tools.name: searchNodes
tools.description: Search for nodes by content or criteria

graphqlOperation.query: query searchNodes($filter: SearchNodesFilter!) { searchNodes(filter: $filter) { nodes { id content table { id identifier } createdAt } } }

tools.name: createRelation
tools.description: Create a relationship between two nodes

graphqlOperation.query: mutation createRelation($input: CreateRelationInput!) { createRelation(input: $input) { success relation { id sourceNode { id } targetNode { id } relationType { identifier } } errors { message } } }
mutation createTemplate($input: CreateQueryTemplateInput!) { createTemplate(input: $input) { success template { id identifier name query tags } errors { message } } }

tools.name: executeTemplateWithGraphQL
tools.description: Execute a template with provided variables using GraphQL engine

graphqlOperation.query: mutation executeTemplateWithGraphQL($templateIdentifier: String!, $variables: JSON!) { executeTemplateWithGraphQL(templateIdentifier: $templateIdentifier, variables: $variables) { success data errors { message } } }

searchTerm.description: Search term for template name or tags

graphqlOperation.query: query searchTemplates($filter: QueryTemplatesFilter) { searchTemplates(filter: $filter) { templates { identifier name query tags } } }

tools.name: exportAllTables
tools.description: Export all tables with metadata and structure

graphqlOperation.query: query exportAllTables { exportAllTables { metadata { exportedAt version } tables { identifier description metadata } } }

tools.name: exportTemplate
tools.description: Export a specific template with all its data

templateIdentifier.description: Identifier of the template to export

graphqlOperation.query: mutation exportTemplate($templateIdentifier: String!) { exportTemplate(templateIdentifier: $templateIdentifier) { success exportData errors { message } } }

tools.name: importTemplate
tools.description: Import a template from JSON data

jsonData.description: JSON data containing the template to import

overwriteExisting.description: Whether to overwrite existing template with same identifier

generateNewIdentifier.description: Whether to generate a new identifier if conflict exists

graphqlOperation.query: mutation importTemplate($jsonData: String!, $overwriteExisting: Boolean, $generateNewIdentifier: Boolean) { importTemplate(jsonData: $jsonData, overwriteExisting: $overwriteExisting, generateNewIdentifier: $generateNewIdentifier) { success template { identifier name } errors { message } } }
